snippet.title: Last Flag | Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Sign up for playtesting: https://www.lastflag.com/signup

Hide your flag. Find the enemy flag. Run it back, then defend for a minute to win it. 

Welcome to Last Flag: a fast-paced 5v5 shooter with showstopping contestants, set in a televised competition where strategy, teamwork, and chaos blend in the ultimate game of Capture the Flag.
Last Flag is the debut title from Night Street Games, an independent game studio on a mission to build multiplayer games crafted with heart.

Wishlist on Steam - https://bit.ly/447aaG9
Wishlist on Epic - https://bit.ly/3MBsUHA

#lastflag #indiegame #teamshooter
